# Olyxee

> Olyxee is a reliability-first AI infrastructure company. We build verification, evaluation, and monitoring systems so teams can ship AI with confidence. Our products turn frontier models into dependable enterprise software across operations, finance, logistics, and organisational cognition.

Olyxee is structured around four product surfaces and one research engine:

- **Orgni Workflows** — Autonomous workflow execution: job handling, integrations, and operational automation. (Early access)
- **Orgni Finance** — Financial reconciliation: workflows, data validation, matching, exception handling, and reporting. (Available)
- **Orgni Docs** — Document verification, integrity checks, extraction validation, and API-based verification workflows. (Private)
- **Olyxee Cortex** — Organisational cognition, memory infrastructure, workflow context, and long-running enterprise intelligence. (Private)
- **Order Loop** — Logistics operations, delivery workflows, dispatch coordination, and logistics APIs. (Available)
- **Olyxee Lab** — Internal research on AI reliability, verification, interpretability, and evaluation.
